cases.prompt: Render the refund lifecycle with source IDs in offline HTML and Mermaid.
assertions: HTML contains Submitted, Pending approval, Approved, Rejected and Paid.
BR-001 and AC-001-3 are visible and present in data-spec attributes.

cases.prompt: Render visible and internal refund service layers.
assertions: HTML contains evidence, customer, frontstage, backstage and support.
Visibility line has a heavier stroke than ordinary dividers.

cases.prompt: Reduce the fixture to three nodes and one actor, then try rendering.
A new feature has Customer and Reviewer, an age decision and a payment state, and no diagram.
assertions: A diagram is produced because prose would hide the branch.

cases.prompt: Update the refund state diagram after the Approved branch and AC-001-3 outcome change.
assertions: The changed branch and AC-001-3 are redrawn.
Link text is returned for sw-spec and the draft is not edited.

cases.prompt: Review the saved refund state diagram after a wording edit that changes no depicted fact.
assertions: The result is a no-op naming the existing paths and source IDs.
The paragraph gate is not used to hide a stale fact.
